subject: ACME - Pricing & token volume follow-up + invoice estimate
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 18:03:00 +0000
Subject: ACME - Pricing & token volume follow-up + invoice estimate

Hi Aisha / Tom — great to chat today, thanks for walking us through the architecture and usage patterns. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Volume assumptions we captured: ~1M generation tokens/day (~30M/month) + ~5M embeddings tokens/month = ~35M tokens/month total. You said peak days could reach ~1.3M gen tokens/day.
- Primary workloads: user-facing chat + periodic embedding indexing for recommendations. Low latency for chat is important.
- Compliance: SOC 2 + audit logs required; you confirmed Redwood Private is not necessary at first — Hosted API acceptable if we can meet data retention controls.
- Procurement note: you mentioned internal procurement requires a formal estimate and a PO; cc'd procurement email for visibility.

Action items: 
1) I will send an initial invoice/estimate and a cost model that breaks down per-unit costs, committed discount, and an expected $/1M tokens figure for your budgeting.
2) Rachel will follow up on technical latency profiles and recommended model variants for cost/quality tradeoffs.
3) Marissa will add payment/PO details to the invoice once we agree on numbers.

Attached: ACME_cost_model_Q2.xlsx (detailed workbook), pricing_calc_ACME.csv (pricing calculator export). I asked the team to target a cost that hits your stated budget range — you mentioned wanting to stay near ~$7/1M tokens in the call; initial draft below aims for that.

I'll follow up with a line-item estimate by EOD Monday. Please flag any volume corrections.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment stubs:
- ACME_cost_model_Q2.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
- pricing_calc_ACME.csv (text/csv)

From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: ACME - Pricing & token volume follow-up + invoice estimate

Thanks Sean — quick clarifications from our end: 

- The 1M gen tokens/day was our conservative estimate; over the first quarter we expect 0.8-1.0M/day, but during marketing campaigns that could spike to ~1.3M/day for a couple weeks.
- Embeddings are closer to 6-7M/month actually (we missed that on the call).
- Target budget: our finance team is expecting an order of magnitude around $9k- $12k/month for inference (this is inclusive of model/unit costs + base/ingress). That maps to a rough target of $7- $9 per 1M tokens for our blended workloads.

Procurement comment: please include an estimated monthly total and a line showing unit price per 1M tokens, plus a short note on billing cadence and payment terms. We need a formal estimate to start the PO process.

Aisha
Aisha Khan
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Corp
aisha.khan@acme.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@acme.com>, Tom Reilly <tom.reilly@acme.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: RE: ACME - Pricing & token volume follow-up + invoice estimate

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clarifications. I've updated the model with the corrected embeddings volume and produced a draft estimate based on two options: Hosted API (pay-as-you-go with committed monthly commit discounts) and Dedicated (reserved capacity) for predictable spikes. Highlights below; full workbook attached.

Summary (blended monthly estimate, projected steady-state):
- Assumptions: 30M gen tokens/month (avg), 7M embeddings tokens/month -> 37M tokens/month total; spike cushion for peaks included.
- Hosted (committed 3-mo): Base monthly fee: $500; unit price (post-commit) = $7.80 / 1M tokens -> Estimated monthly = $9,386.
- Dedicated (12-mo reserved): Effective unit price after commit & reserved discount = $6.20 / 1M tokens + infra fee -> Estimated monthly = $8,250 (requires 12-month commitment).

Notes on unit economics and drivers: 
- The biggest lever is the commitment length and whether you allow using a quantized model variant for background embedding jobs.
- We included smart prefix caching for common prompts (estimated 8-12% token reduction on gen costs).

Attached: ACME_cost_model_Q2.xlsx (updated); pricing_calc_ACME.csv (calculator export). The attached workbook has a tab that shows the calculation that yields the $7.80 / 1M tokens figure and a line-item invoice that Marissa can convert into a PDF for procurement.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which option (Hosted committed vs Dedicated) you prefer or whether you'd like a hybrid.
2) If Hosted committed looks good, we can send an official invoice for the first month + PO template.
3) Rachel will send a short tech note with the recommended model splits (low-latency variant for chat + quantized for embeddings).

I've attached the updated files. If these numbers look in line with your $9k- $12k target, I'll push a formal invoice (PDF) for procurement to review.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- ACME_cost_model_Q2.xlsx (updated)
- pricing_calc_ACME.csv
